Gaw-La Furia - Interior
Fu-Ruu
Lord Gu-Landon,@Fu-Ruu Muru, reporting as summoned.
Gu-Landon
Good.@Fu-Ruu, I charge you with retrieving the Throne Unit.
My, isn't that Al-Van's job?
Where E-Selda is involved, that man cannot be fully@ruthless. And with Ru-Kuku Vodyu, the Gate of Voda,@open once more, Vaula could appear at any time.
Thus we cannot be particular about the means@of retrieving the Throne Unit.
Could it be... you're telling me@to break the knights' taboo?
Can you do it?
...If my existence is no longer needed.
Heh... I jest. Forget it.@Only three knights survived that great war,@myself included.
I need you to serve as my aide,@and as instructor to the young@Junior Knights and Squires.
I'm well aware of that.
But it is a fact that we must retrieve@the Throne Unit with all haste.
According to Al-Van's report,@Lord E-Selda's son boarded Granteed@and even activated Busker Mode.
What of it?
No one could achieve that without a fine knight's@aptitude. All the more so if he drove back Al-Van@with so little combat experience.
I cannot acknowledge a product of E-Selda's plan.@It denies the bloodline handed down unbroken@from Fureim, the God of Creation.
Not even worth making use of?
That's right.
The Throne Unit matters more than a counterfeit.@Even with the divine dragon Basileus remaining,@my plan cannot be fulfilled without it.
Yes, my lord. Leave it to me.
To ensure success, I have summoned someone.@...Come forth, So-Des Zuo.
So-Des
Hey there.
That attitude... is rude to Lord Gu-Landon.
The codes of knights don't really apply to us Agents.
Could it be, Lord Gu-Landon...@you mean to let this one use the forbidden art?
You're perceptive. Exactly.
The Throne Unit's Larseilam@was destroyed by Lord Karo-Ran.@Which means they have no way to defend against it.
What about a Raftclans?@All you Agents have is the Chief Agent's Karokuala.
Exactly right, but@the Holy Knights will be providing one.
Lord Gu-Landon, is that true?
Mm.
(I see, so that's why Karo-Ran@agreed to this...)
(If we supply the Raftclans,@he can save his Karokuala's Eitelum.)
Oh, it's an honor far beyond what I deserve.@Normally, only those of captain rank or knights@can handle that unit.
Besides, I have no qualms whatsoever@about using Larseilam. Unlike you knights.
Even without Her Highness's permission?
Well, that would be going too far...
(...A lie. He'll push it through on his own@authority even if he's reproached later?@And that Karo-Ran actually agreed to this...)
(No, perhaps Karo-Ran simply wanted@Lord Gu-Landon to owe him a favor.)
Lady Fu-Ruu,@all you need to do is lure out the <Steel Dragons>@and the Throne Unit. I'll take care of the rest.
A knight playing decoy for an Agent...@Isn't that backwards?
Fu-Ruu, I do not mean to order you to cast aside@your pride as a knight. But know that retrieving@the Throne Unit swiftly is key to our long-held goal.
...As you wish.
Earth Federation Army Far East Command, Izu Base
Izu Base Headquarters
Sakae
Commander, the Hiryu Custom has returned to port@via the Bay of Biscay.
Laker
Did Envoy Bryan Midcrid@arrive safely in Paris?
If the latest timetable holds, yes.
I'd like to hear what happened out there, but...
It seems the Joint Chiefs of Staff have issued@a gag order to the entire Hiryu Custom crew.
Then we'll have to wait for the report.
No, Brigadier General Miles has requested a meeting.@You may receive a briefing on the mission then.
I see. Then let's pray it's good news.
Izu Base - Pier
Man, a lot happened, but the trip home was smooth.
Seriously. Almost anticlimactic.
Come on, we got into three firefights on the way out.@If something happened on the way back too,@I couldn't take it.
...In the end, a lot of things are still unresolved.@Even though we went almost as far as Mars orbit.
The important results are classified, after all.
Could we end up@fighting Gadisword too...
For now, I think that's unlikely.
Yeah.@It's not like we got kicked out of Rabulpaila,@or ran home with our tails between our legs.
Remember, there's a gag order in effect.@Be careful once we're off the Hiryu.
Yeah, I know.
Hm? Somebody's here to meet us.
It's Major Gilliam. I wonder what's happened.
...I believe he's here for me.
Lieutenant Yon... Thank you for your work@on the Hiryu Custom's mission.
Not at all... Though I can't discuss the details.
About that... By order of the Joint Chiefs of Staff,@I'd like you to report to Mekibos Borquede@in my presence. They want his opinion.
To my master's... Understood.
Izu Base - Interior
Wow! You came to Izu, Joshy?
Yes. Rim, Glacies, and Cliff are with me.
Hmm, did something happen in Antarctica?@Maybe that's why you came@to pick up the Geant Chevalier?
(Sharp as ever, Lieutenant Excellen...)
Like the Hiryu Custom's mission, that's classified.@Don't ask any further.
Aw, shucks.
(...Something big must have happened in Antarctica.)
Sorry, Joshy.
No.
Sounds like a lot happened in Japan too.
Yes. Tokyo, Yokohama, and Chiba came under@simultaneous Zovorg attack... But those were@diversions. Their real target was Izu.
That's right... A <Thorn> showed up here.
The type we ran into in space?
No. That one I'll never forget...@The gray Thorn that destroyed@<Ashurey Kreuzer>.
So you ran into your enemy. And?
(Good grief. She looks like she got beaten back.)
Major Kai, did you fight the Thorn too?
No, the Instructors weren't there.@Those who fought were Gilliam, Calvina, Melua,@the Akatsuki siblings, Touya and Katia.
I hear Touya in particular unleashed Granteed's@power and drove off the Thorn.
Huh... We fought that thing in space,@and it gave us a fair bit of trouble.
He says it's thanks to the Cytron Control System...@Granteed's man-machine interface,@but there are a lot of mysteries there too.
It resonated with the <Sympathia>@built into my unit.
Huh? Why not?
Actually, the Cytron Control System is similar@to the Sympathia in concept and structure...
No, it'd be more accurate to say that simplifying@that system gives you the Sympathia.
Huh...?
Seriously?
How did you figure that out?
Don't tell me it has something to do@with the <Fabula Foresse>.
Yes. When we examined@Granteed's cockpit...
The characters displayed there were the same@as the ones inscribed on the Fabula Foresse.
Th-Then...
The intelligent life-forms that built@the Fabula Foresse made Granteed...
Probably.
Good grief, who knew there was a link like that?
According to Dr. Wan, Granteed was built@at least a thousand years ago.
Just like the <Choukijin>...
...The Thorn pilot who appeared at Izu@said Granteed belonged to them.
Those who possess it and the Thorn... The group@Touya's father, Seldoa Shiun, seems to have@belonged to may be unrelated to the Zovorg.
On what grounds?
Something I heard from Gilliam... At the end of@the Sealing War, Zovorg weapons used by <Zezenan>@and his people were abandoned in space...
And it seems they may have been@captured by another faction.
Another faction... <Balmar>?
I can't say for sure. It could be other aliens.
(I doubt it's Gadisword, though.)
If the ones who built the Fabula Foresse@are somewhere in the Earth Sphere...
It bugs me that they didn't react when Re-Tech@found the ruins, or when Ruina appeared@in the Sealing War.
Just as our fathers discovered the Fabula Foresse@and obtained the Sympathia and the Res Arcana...
Someone may simply have obtained Granteed@somewhere and been using it.
If Touya can use the Cytron System, can't we@find out who built it, and when and where?@There must be data like that inside the unit.
We thought the same thing@and had them try, but no luck.
Why not?
This is Cliff's guess... but there may be some@restriction on the unit's side, so it only tells@Touya and the others the bare minimum.
So it's tight-lipped, huh?
(The Thorn's pilot knew Touya, though Touya didn't@know him. And Seldoa Shiun... Are they Earthlings@with ties to aliens, or perhaps...)
Clifford
So, what were the scan results?
Kenzo
Seldoa Shiun's cerebral hemispheres...@There was a difference in the sulci@of the parietal lobe.
The parietal lobe...
It's the lobe that governs spatial perception and@integrates information from all parts of the body,@such as skin and deep sensations.
Then what's this difference in the sulci?
Sulci are what you'd call the brain's wrinkles...@Their depth and curvature vary between people,@but their positions are completely fixed.
However, the positions of the sulci in Seldoa's@parietal lobe differed slightly from a normal@person's.
This is only speculation... but that area may be@involved in operating the Cytron Control System.
To begin with, it's unclear what the word "Cytron"@that Touya and the others use actually refers to.
Something that affects the brain's neuronal@action potentials... No, it may be something@that exists outside the brain.
Then what do you think would happen if someone@like Seldoa Shiun brought the Cytron Control@System's functions to bear in full?
First, the synchronization and information@exchange with the machine that Touya and the others@already do would move to a more advanced level.
Next would be heightened awareness@within a given space centered on oneself...
And communion with others using the same system.@Up to this point, it would be the same as the Sympathia.
You mean the original,@the Cytron Control System,@has even more functions?
Yes. Though I can't say for certain what they are.
Even a guess would do.
...Further expansion of self-awareness, mental@communion over long distances, foresight of what@may happen. And...
No, I'll stop there.@It concerns my own research.
...I see.@Then let me ask one last question.@Do you think Seldoa Shiun was an alien?
Hard to say.@Based on our findings so far, he's no different@from an Earthling, apart from the parietal sulci.
Mekibos
Good work on the Rabulpaila mission.
Thank you, Master.
Who's their leader?
A civil official named Malum Quisude.@I also met someone named Herluga Isberga,@the one in charge of Rabulpaila.
What was your impression?
I'd say Quisude is a gentle moderate,@and Isberga a belligerent, ambitious type.
I see...@Then tell me how they came to the solar system.
It seems the Gadisword people were split@into several factions on their home planet@and had long been in a state of civil war...
And the space fortress Rabulpaila was one@of the things that brought the fighting to an end.
I saw the footage. It's got a huge cannon on the tip.@Looks more powerful than the main cannon@of a Uyudaro-class suppression gunship.
I couldn't confirm whether that's a weapon,@but they seem to possess many mobile weapons.
Rabulpaila is also equipped@with a space-warp device.
Though it's extremely large-scale,@and apparently can't be mass-produced.
So when it comes to warp technology,@they're several steps behind us Zovorg.
Yes, sir.
Go on.
After the civil war ended, the planet Gadisword@was suddenly attacked by a group@of unidentified mobile weapons.
Rabulpaila's people speculate they were new@weapons another faction built that ran amok in@an accident, or perhaps alien invasion weapons...
They threw all of planet Gadisword into chaos@in the blink of an eye, and as a result,@many lives and cities were lost.
Amid that, the spaceship Malum Quisude was aboard@was attacked, and he had to take refuge in Rabulpaila,@which was on a war footing. And then...
Rabulpaila attempted a space warp to defend@the capital... but the device went haywire,@and they were flung to the solar system.
...That's a strange story.
Yes. To reach the solar system in a single warp@from a star system so distant that even the Zovorg@don't know of it or where it is...
Either their warp device is special,@or some force was at work...@Either way, it shouldn't normally be possible.
...Though they could be visitors@from a parallel world.
Did you find out the real reason Gadisword wants@to conclude a peace treaty with Earth?
Rabulpaila's propulsion system and warp device@are severely damaged, and they can't repair them@with their stockpiled supplies alone...
As a result, it's now on a trajectory falling into the sun.
Looks like they could change course with the recoil@from firing that cannon on the tip...@Is there some reason they can't?
Well, even if they avoid falling into the sun,@that won't solve all their problems.
Three demands: leave to stay in the solar system,@asylum from the Earth Federation Government, and@supplies to fix Rabulpaila's engines and warp device.
Now, what'll Earth's government decide...?@Maybe it'd be better if we Zovorg@just took them in ourselves.
Wouldn't that be interfering in internal affairs?
I suppose.
(...No doubt some in the Federation government@would love to push this mess onto the Zovorg...)
...Now that's a strange story.
Yes. To reach the solar system in a single warp@from a star system so distant that even the <Zovorg>@don't know of it or where it is...
Either Rabulpaila's warp device is special,@or some force was at work...@Either way, it shouldn't normally be possible.
Master... Actually, at Rabulpaila we were attacked@by a mobile force we believe was the <Golaikunru>.
What...
So they were aware of Gadisword too.
And what about Gadisword?@Did they know about the Golaikunru?
They didn't seem to,@but there's room for doubt.
...This is gonna get messy.@I'll check all of it with the homeland.
Please do.
Yon, keep operating with the Steel Dragons.@Let me know if anything comes up.
Understood, Master.
Mekibos, about the Hagane's space-warp device@that the Joint Chiefs of Staff requested...
Yeah... After this Golaikunru business, we'll have@to get it ready before they lodge a protest.@I'll push for it with the higher-ups too.
Saika
Major Gilliam.
Lieutenant... Were you waiting outside?
Yes, there's something I wish to report.
Then, Major... I'll go on ahead.
Yeah.
So, what's the report?
Sleeping Beauty has regained consciousness.@So far, she shows no physical abnormalities.
I see... Can she be questioned?@Assuming we can understand each other, of course.
...The language Sleeping Beauty uses@doesn't seem to be from Earth.
As I thought. Then go to her and keep watch.@Communicate as much as you can, and try@to show her that we aren't her enemy.
With gestures, you mean?
I'll leave the method to you.@I'll come as soon as the meetings are over.
Roger.
Hagane - Hangar
Eric
...This is strictly the Earth concept, mind you,@but orgone is an energy that exists in nature,@something like the "qi" defined in Taoism.
Qi...
It's similar to Terminus Energy, which powers@the TE Absorbers that Hugo and Aqua@of the Instructors pilot.
Tenia
What's that?
Its existence was predicted in addition to@the four forces of nature: gravity, electromagnetism,@and the strong and weak interactions.
Ugh, I don't really get it.
Robert
...If it's called an Extractor,@it must extract the orgone found in nature.
Katia
Does that mean...@it keeps being supplied with energy?
If the hypothesis is correct, that is.
Melua
This one's amazing, isn't it?
I mean, aren't you getting information@through the Cytron Control System?
We only know how to use it,@not how it works...
...Katia, Tenia, Melua.@There's something I want to talk to you about.
About what comes next?
Yeah... I want to know. Who Dad really was...@why he entrusted Granteed to me... And who@the enemy is and what they're after...
I have lots of other questions too. To find@the answers, I think I have no choice but@to keep fighting in Granteed.
If I don't pilot it, my life might be safe...@But I feel like then@I'll never reach the truth.
I can't move Granteed by myself.@So I want the three of you to lend me your strength.
I'm in.@I've already decided to avenge my mom and dad@and the others with Calvina.
I... want to know the truth too.@I don't want to stay in the dark.
Then it's settled.
...You're sure?
Right now... it's the only thing I can do.
Understood...
(Learning the truth won't bring Dad back...@or the parents of Katia, Melua, and Tenia...)
(But I can't just forget and go on living.@Not me, and not any of us...)
Well, it's about time.@The four of you are to get checked by Dr. Kobayashi.
...Understood.
Hagane - Commander's Office
Daniel
...Touya Shiun, Katia Grineal, Melua Melna Meia,@and Festenia Muse, who are likely their targets,@are to be made <Military Contractor>...
...and to accompany the Steel Dragons. This is@by order of His Excellency, Marshal Gaspar Gilan.
Miles
(To think His Excellency places@such importance on those children...)
If Touya Shiun and the others refuse,@appropriate measures, legal and otherwise,@will be taken.
That won't be necessary.@Touya and the other three have volunteered@to cooperate with our fleet of their own will.
Then they are also permitted to board Granteed@and fight. Sorties are at your discretion,@but don't let the enemy seize it.
In other words, His Excellency wants us to be@a decoy that draws the unknown forces' attention,@and to repel them as they come.
Not only that.@He is also hoping you'll uncover@their identity and objectives.
Sir!
Make sure not to lose Granteed or Bellzelute.@And don't neglect your watch on the five people@involved, including Lieutenant Calvina Coulange.
Understood.
Then I'm counting on you.@It should be possible for you and the Steel Dragons.
(Should be possible, hm? Needless to say.@I've been prepared since the day I took on@that bunch of troublemakers...)
(Even if it means playing the decoy.)
Azuki
Commander, it's time for your briefing@with Major General Laker. Please come@to the base's No. 4 conference room.
Yes, I'll be right there.
...And that is how the peace negotiations@with Gadisword played out.
Tetsuya
(So that's what happened...)
(So the Lefina detachment made contact@with a new race of aliens...)
In addition, Chief Malum Quisude has requested@a search for a certain person.
Her name is Fairy Klibia. She's the Chief's guard,@but she reportedly stole a fighter, deserted,@and infiltrated Earth.
(A fighter...?)
Her reason for deserting is unknown.@Then again, if she were a spy or saboteur,@they wouldn't openly ask us to search for her...
Here is her personal data.
Wh-What is this?!
(Sleeping Beauty...!)
Hmm... That's no mere resemblance.
Commander, you know her...?!
...I'd like this kept top secret.@The truth is, a woman closely resembling this@Fairy Klibia is under protection at this base.
We're also holding the unit she was piloting...@code name: Drift Wing.
Th-Then we can interrogate Fairy Klibia...!
Major Gilliam, I've been told she's awake,@but can she be questioned?
Let's give it a try.@Brigadier General Miles, can we use a translator?
Yes... The high-performance Zovorg translator provided@by Lieutenant Yon Gebana and Gadisword's translation@protocols have made conversation easy.
Then let's begin.
Izu Base - Courtyard
Come on, this way, Sleeping Beauty.
Ii zoo au aa...@Rooru doogu...
She seems... happy.
Ii dono bamen miipasu...@Waahii aazu...
Now something's bothering her?
So this is where you were, Lieutenant.
Oh, Major...
I never imagined you'd take her out of her hospital room.
I was trying to carry out your earlier orders, sir...
I said I'd leave the method to you, but this is too bold.
I-I'm very sorry.
By the way, what about her clothes?
I prepared them so she'd pass as someone with@<Mogami Heavy Industries>. She blends in, while@those in the know can easily pick her out.
I've already informed Mr. Jinpu Kawanishi...@Would a military uniform have been better?
No... More importantly, let's get her back to her room.
Major Gilliam... Who's that woman?
She's wearing Mogami clothes, but... who is she?
...! Fio... Gaguri...
Huh?
Sorry, but we're in a hurry.
Fio...
What did she say when she looked at me?
No idea... Who on earth was she?
I've never seen her before.
Then I'll ask Jinpu.
Izu Base - Special Ward
Major, the translator is installed.
Good... Let's switch it on.
Fairy
My name is Gilliam Jaeger.@Are you... Fairy Klibia?
...I am... Yes, my name is... Fairy...
(That settles it...)
You came from Gadisword's Rabulpaila.@Is that correct?
I-I don't know...
I don't know... I can't remember...@Wh-What am I...?
Huh...
(Could it be...)
When we left that place earlier,@you looked at a boy and said something.@What did it mean?
...Fio... was alive...
What is Fio? A person's name?
I don't... know who...
(So it's a person's name, at least?)
Then what did you mean by "was alive"?
I don't know...@why I said that...
(...Amnesia, then.)
Izu Base - Hangar
Hey, Jinpu.@Earlier we met a woman wearing@Mogami clothes. Who is she?
Jinpu
Mogami clothes...?
A real beauty with short hair.
(Oh, he means Sleeping Beauty?@These two ran into her...?!)
Izu Base - Command Center
Operator
Report from <S-AWACS>! Unidentified mobile@weapons have warped in at Mizutori Island!
Why an island with nothing but a training@ground, and not Izu Base...?
Most likely a diversion. We'll split the Steel@Dragons to respond. The Hagane stands by at Izu.@Send the Hiryu Custom to Mizutori Island.
Also, Granteed, Bellzelute and the Geant@Chevalier will go to Mizutori Island.@That way we'll see how the enemy responds.
So the Hagane's mobile units will defend@the Drift Wing here at the base.
Yes. We'll divide the enemy's attention.
I keep tellin' you, your job@as a test pilot is over!
But the Soul Saber evaluation tests@got postponed, didn't they?!
That ain't the point! I'm sayin'@you don't need to fight on a battlefield!
Jinpu, I... Fighting in the Soul Saber@isn't what I'm after...!
You wanna protect the Earth, right?@Leave that to the pros in the military.
Touya, Katia, Tenia and Melua are fighting too.
Those four have their reasons,@and they can make Granteed move.
I've got the Soul Saber too. With it, I wanna@do what I can... whatever I'm able to, right now.
...Yes.
Akemi, you too...
Until recently, I planned to stay behind@the scenes as a test pilot.
But there are enemies attacking us...@and there are things I want to protect,@things I have to protect...
Goin' out on a battlefield@ain't all pretty ideals...
Yeah, I'm scared. I might change someone's fate,@not just my own... I'm prepared for that.
But when people who have no power@to fight back get hurt...
Please, Jinpu.
(So this is my punishment after all...)
Jinpu...!
...Fine. Fine, but on one condition.
What's that?
You both come back, no matter what. Got it?
Yeah! Let's go, Akemi!
Right!
...They've come. All units, prepare to intercept.
Heh, they sent out Granteed@more obediently than I expected.
They mean it as a decoy or bait, guarding it closely@and keeping it back... but it's no use.@Contact So-Des.
Agent
My, what a coincidence.@Even the "key" that sealed Vaula is here.
(...Shall I test it with <Sympathia>?)
This reaction...@I see, so it isn't active@at all times.
(There's a reaction... A Cytron Control System@in something that isn't a Zovorg unit...?)
Counterfeit or not,@I'd love to get it and study it...
That's the <Thorn> we ran into in space.
Yeah, no doubt about it.
They didn't leave these waters because@they were waiting for us... for Granteed?
Most likely, yes.
(I'll capture that Thorn and@make them tell me who they are.)
(And who attacked@the Ashurey Kreuzer, too.)
Touya, stay close to the Hiryu.@Depending on the situation, I'll order you back.
Please don't do anything reckless.@If we were captured by the enemy...
I know, but@tell Calvina that, too.
With that enemy out there,@we can't just watch from the back.
(Will he come after us too...@like that man who called himself a knight?)
With the Steel Dragons here, we're safe, right?
I hope so...
Rear guard, secure So-Des's transfer coordinates.@Vanguard, split up the enemy well.
Eleve 1 to all units! Commence attack!
